subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the published `qaChannelMessageActions` adapter permanently define canonical `target`/`threadName`/`message` values as winning over conflicting legacy aliases?
rationale: The implementation can preserve either behavior mechanically, but the public conflict rule is a compatibility policy choice that should be explicitly accepted by an owner rather than inferred from an external PR.

options.title: Approve canonical-first precedence
options.body: Accept the branch’s tested rule so shared message-runner fields are authoritative while legacy-only direct callers remain compatible.

options.title: Preserve legacy precedence
options.body: Ask for a narrow follow-up changing the conflict rule if existing direct consumers must retain authority when both representations are provided.

options.title: Specify a rejection rule
options.body: Require conflicting canonical and legacy values to fail validation if silent precedence is not an acceptable long-term public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical-first precedence
recommendation.body: Accept the branch’s tested rule so shared message-runner fields are authoritative while legacy-only direct callers remain compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is plugin API compatibility direction rather than a mechanical QA-bus repair.
